Sobie-Curry daily morphing method

Source: R/shift-stage.R
sobie_curry_daily.Rd

sobie_curry_daily() creates the paper-faithful daily method described by Sobie and Curry (2025). It requires matching historical and future daily tas, tasmin, tasmax, huss, and ps inputs.

The method estimates calendar-neutral change factors with the published 21-day circular window, preserves the baseline CWEC/EPW sequence, and independently transforms dry-bulb temperature, dew point, relative humidity, and surface pressure. Other hourly EPW fields remain unchanged.

sobie_curry_daily(reference = NULL, window_days = 21L)

Arguments

reference

A required historical_reference(), shift_reference_plan(), or extracted ShiftClimate stage.

window_days

Odd circular climatology-window width in days. The published setting is 21.

Value

A complete ShiftMorphMethod for shift_future_epw().

See also

daily_temperature(), shift_cmip6(), shift_future_epw()
